summary: Dependent-resource sync warnings are JSON-marshaled so NUL-composite ids no longer break NDJSON: every hand-assembled sync/reconcile event line now renders data-derived parent and scope ids through a jsonString helper instead of raw %s interpolation.
reason: Dependent resources store NUL-composite ids (<uuid>\x00<parent_uuid>, engine-4.27 shape). sync's hand-assembled NDJSON event lines interpolated those ids raw via fmt.Fprintf %s, so any per-parent sync_warning/sync_anomaly/reconcile event for a nested dependent emitted a literal 0x00 byte inside a JSON string, making the line invalid JSON. Dogfood's json_fidelity check then failed `sync --json` (surfaced once the init fix let dependent syncs reach real parent rows). Event shape and field set are unchanged; only the escaping is corrected (json.Marshal emits the escape form JSON requires).
patch_tags: PATCH(plane-sync-warning-nul-json) in internal/cli/helpers.go: jsonString helper directly above syncWarningJSON renders a data-derived value as a JSON string literal via json.Marshal (quotes included).

PATCH(plane-sync-warning-nul-json) in internal/cli/sync.go: dependent/per-parent event emits render parent ids via jsonString: `"parent":%s` with jsonString(parent|a.parent|parentID) in the sync_warning arms (pagination_cursor_missing, max_pages_cap_hit, stuck_pagination) and sync_anomaly arms (all_items_failed_id_extraction, primary_key_unresolved, non_json_200_body).

PATCH(plane-sync-warning-nul-json) in internal/cli/sync.go: reconcile event emits render scope ids via jsonString: `"scope":%s` with jsonString(tenantUUID|outcome.scopeVal) in the reconcile, reconcile_error, and reconcile_skipped lines of both the top-level and dependent reconcile paths.
validated_outcome: go build ./... + go vet ./... green. TestJSONStringEscapesNULCompositeIDs proves a warning line carrying a NUL-composite parent id is valid JSON and the id round-trips exactly. Live dogfood gate rerun green after the fix (sync --json json_fidelity passes).
deferred_to_upstream: The same raw-Fprintf emit pattern lives in the generator template that prints sync.go, so every printed CLI with NUL-composite dependent ids inherits the bug; needs a machine fix in cli-printing-press.
